properties.name: Machu Picchu
properties.description: Inca citadel at 2,430m in the Andes. Intihuatana stone ('hitching post of the sun') aligned with solstices. Sacred landscape architecture.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, New Seven Wonders of the World

properties.name: Lake Titicaca — Birthplace of the Sun
properties.description: The highest navigable lake (3,812m). Viracocha rose from its depths to create the sun, moon, and first humans on the Island of the Sun.

properties.name: Cusco — Navel of the World
properties.description: Inca capital designed in the shape of a puma. Four roads led to the four quarters of the empire. Coricancha (Temple of the Sun) was covered in gold.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, vibrant living city

properties.name: Nazca Lines
properties.description: Massive geoglyphs visible only from the air — hummingbirds, monkeys, spiders — created by the Nazca culture. Aligned with water sources and celestial events.

properties.name: Tiwanaku
properties.description: Pre-Inca civilization's capital near Lake Titicaca. Gateway of the Sun shows Viracocha surrounded by attendant figures.
